title: Kalshi Moves to Expand Into US Stock and Commodity Markets
description: Kalshi Inc. is filing for regulatory approval to offer the first single-stock perpetual futures in the US and is looking to expand the contracts in commodities to include agriculture, said Tarek Mansour, the company’s co-founder.

title: Larry Ellison Steps Back From Oracle Limelight in AI Era
description: Oracle Corp. earnings calls this year have been missing a familiar voice: Larry Ellison’s.

title: Oracle Boosts Layoffs Plan by $700 Million
description: Oracle Corp. increased the scale of its planned job cuts while the company grapples with a cash crunch tied to development of large-scale data centers for artificial intelligence work.
